title: Warm Climates May Have Helped Crocodile Kin Outlast the Dinosaurs
paragraphs: Sixty-six million years ago, an asteroid hit Earth. Many animals died. The dinosaurs died too.
But crocodiles and their relatives lived. A new study asks why. Scientists looked at over 7,000 fossils and records.
The study says warm places helped them. Near the equator, it stayed warm. Crocodile relatives could live there. Scientists say other things helped too.
